vibe: Technical, Data-Dense, Linear/Vercel Aesthetic, High Structural Clarity

hierarchy.code_block: font-mono text-sm bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300

rules: No Inter, Open Sans, or Roboto for headings.
Metrics and numeric values (like commit counts, PRs) MUST use JetBrains Mono.
Labels (Overlines) MUST be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-widest.
Avoid all purple and teal gradients.
Keep default view monochrome (black, zinc, white).
Use color EXCLUSIVELY to indicate status (e.g., green for open PR, red for issue).
Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for dense metrics.
Every widget must have h-full to stretch uniformly.
Cards have internal padding of p-6 to prevent content collision with borders.
Optical alignment: Icons on the left of buttons should have extra visual space before text.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat background (bg-zinc-950), 1px subtle border (border-zinc-800), NO shadow.
surface_strategies.hover_state: Slight border highlight (border-zinc-600) and bg shift (bg-zinc-900), no aggressive lift.
surface_strategies.navigation: Solid background (bg-zinc-950) with hard bottom border (border-zinc-800). No glassmorphism.

components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm, high contrast. Primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-800 text-white hover:bg-zinc-900.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but override radius to rounded-sm. border-zinc-800, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white bg-zinc-950 text-white.
components.tables: Dense layout. text-sm. Hover effect on rows. Header rows use font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500.
components.badges: Minimal. border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-300.
components.icons: lucide-react (stroke-width 1.5, size 16 for inline, 20 for standalone).

interactions_and_motion.hover: Transition border-color and bg-color 150ms ease. Text color must always maintain APCA contrast on hover.
interactions_and_motion.loading: Use ASCII-style loaders or subtle linear indeterminate progress bars (1px height).

testing.requirement: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

login_background.description: Abstract dark geometry for the login page background
login_background.usage: Use with heavy opacity overlay (bg-black/80) to ensure login form legibility.

team_avatars.usage: Use in team member lists and avatar groups.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the JSON structure for colors and typography. The file is meant to govern the full aesthetic direction.
Do NOT use Shadcn Card component default shadows and heavy borders; override them to bg-transparent or bg-zinc-950 with 1px zinc-800 borders and NO shadows.
Implement navigation as a sticky top bar or left sidebar with solid bg, NOT blurred/glass.
Ensure all metric numbers (e.g. '12 Commits', '4 Open PRs') use the 'mono_font' (JetBrains Mono).
Avoid Vercel's default 'Inter' font. Use 'Chivo' for headers and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body.
Ensure ALL buttons, links, inputs, and metric cards have `data-testid` attributes following the format `feature-element-role`.
Use Lucide-React for all icons. Avoid importing other icon libraries to maintain consistency.
Do not use generic placeholders for images. Use the URLs provided in the `media_and_assets` section.
Build standard React (.js/.jsx) components, NOT Typescript. The project is Javascript based.
Ensure all interactive components and layouts are fully responsive (mobile-first).
